sources.note: Colorado State University Office of International Programs / International Enrollment Center page for the OAS Scholarship at CSU — the awarding body's own page, read in full on 12 October 2026.

awarding_body.detail: The page is on CSU's official colostate.edu domain (International Enrollment Center section) and is the scholarship's own programme page, not an aggregator. It confirms CSU as the awarding body in partnership with the OAS, matching the record.
awarding_body.quote: In partnership with the Organization of American States (OAS), Colorado State University offers scholarships to qualified candidates of the Americas to participate in on-campus Academic Programs at CSU.

deadline.detail: The page publishes no closing date or deadline. It states applications are open only for newly admitted students entering Fall 2027, which is the currently open cycle as of 12 October 2026. This matches the record's rolling / no-closing-date label.
deadline.quote: Only newly admitted students for Fall 2027 will be considered at this time. Students admitted to the SPUR campus are also not eligible.

eligibility.detail: All eligibility claims in the record are confirmed: admission to a degree-seeking on-campus program at the Fort Collins campus; only transfer undergraduate or graduate students (new first-year students excluded); SPUR campus students excluded; citizenship of a listed OAS member economy (US citizens and permanent residents excluded); holders of a full departmental assistantship excluded. The member-economy list on the page (Antigua and Barbuda through Venezuela) excludes the United States.
eligibility.quote: Must be admitted to a degree-seeking, on-campus, program at Colorado State University’s Fort Collins Campus. ... New, first-year students are not eligible for the OAS Scholarship. We will only consider transfer undergraduate or graduate students. ... Only citizens of the member economies listed below are eligible to apply for the OAS scholarship. ... Students who have been awarded a full assistantship by their department are not eligible to receive the OAS scholarship. ... U.S. citizens and permanent residents, including those who hold dual U.S. citizenship and citizenship of a member economy country, are not eligible for the OAS scholarship.

funding.detail: The award is a partial tuition waiver: recipients receive one third off non-resident tuition. It is not fully funded (no travel, stipend, or living support is mentioned), which agrees with the record's 'Tuition Fee Waiver' funding type. The page also notes it cannot be combined with a graduate assistantship.
funding.quote: OAS scholarship recipients will receive 1/3 off non-resident tuition for all degree seeking on-campus program

degree_levels.detail: The page offers the scholarship at undergraduate (Bachelor's) and graduate level, with graduate described as 'Master's degree or higher' — doctoral students are graduate students, so PhD is covered by that wording, matching the record's Bachelor's / Master's / PhD. The application form's program options are undergraduate and graduate at the Fort Collins campus (plus SPUR campus, which is ineligible).

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: Only newly admitted students for Fall 2027 will be considered at this time.
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: CSU republishes the target admission term each year (currently Fall 2027); the page shows no closing date, so re-check annually before the next admissions cycle. Eligibility hinges on the listed OAS member economies, the transfer-student-only rule, the SPUR campus exclusion, and the full-assistantship exclusion — all stated verbatim on the page. Award is a 1/3 non-resident tuition discount, not fully funded.

notes_for_reviewer: Record can be moved to active. Minor wording notes for a human: (1) the CSU page does not use the word 'PhD' — it says graduate students seek 'a Master's degree or higher', so the record's PhD level is an inference from that phrase; (2) the page's own deadline wording is only the Fall 2027 admission-term line, with no closing date published anywhere on the page.
